name: A Chef's Oncoming Breakdown.
source:
What does it take to become the best girlfriend you can be? How far do you have to go? How much of yourself do you have to sacrifice? How much sleep do you lose? The meals you skip? The medicine you stop taking? The things you leave unsaid?

When does one break?

Giulia, a cooking school student and girlfriend to a bare-knuckle brawler, wants to be the best she can be for her cool girlfriend (according to Giulia), Fern. She wants to be the person Fern can depend on and count on, and this has been going well for a while, but everything gives in eventually. You only have so much to give, and at some point, things break down.

And when they do, they do so violently.

[From [url=https://tangledvirus.itch.io/a-chefs-oncoming-breakdown]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
怎样才能成为最好的女朋友？你还要走多远？你需要牺牲多少自己？你失去了多少睡眠？你不吃的饭菜？你停止服用的药？你没有说出来的事情？

一个人什么时候会断？

朱莉娅是一名烹饪学校的学生，也是一名赤裸裸的打架者的女朋友，她想为她的酷女友弗恩（根据朱莉娅的说法）做到最好。她想成为弗恩可以依靠和依靠的人，这已经有一段时间进展顺利，但一切最终都会屈服。你只能付出这么多，但到了某个时候，事情就会崩溃。

当他们这样做时，他们会非常暴力。

[来自[url=https://tangledvirus.itch.io/a-chefs-oncoming-breakdown]itch.io[/url]]
